ITEM 1 | Large heap of white, opaque, soft crumbly pieces with irregular rounded edges, covering roughly 35-40% of the plate on the left side, piled 2-3 cm high, with slightly moist, fluffy texture and no sheen or browning | 260
ITEM 2 | Cubes of orange-brown roasted or baked vegetable with browned, slightly caramelized edges and darker patches, about 2-3 cm pieces, clustered in the upper right area covering roughly 15% of the plate, 1.5-2.5 cm high, with a matte, dry-looking surface | 130
ITEM 3 | Cubed pale orange fruit with smooth, firm, slightly glossy skin-free faces, about 1.5-2 cm pieces, scattered among the watermelon in the lower right area, covering roughly 8% of the plate, 1-1.5 cm high, juicy-looking | 70
ITEM 4 | Cubed bright pink-red fruit with smooth, moist surfaces and visible seeds-free flesh, about 2 cm pieces, arranged in a cluster in the lower right area covering roughly 10% of the plate, 1.5-2 cm high, juicy with slight sheen | 85
